exposure.needed: whether dashboards, alerts or recording rules query the metric cilium_node_connectivity_latency_seconds

consequence.statement: The metric cilium_node_connectivity_latency_seconds is deprecated in 1.17. Anything that queries it should move to cilium_node_health_connectivity_latency_seconds.
consequence.remediation: Update dashboards, alerts and queries to use cilium_node_health_connectivity_latency_seconds.

assertion.statement: In Cilium 1.17 the metric cilium_node_connectivity_latency_seconds is deprecated, and users should use cilium_node_health_connectivity_latency_seconds instead.
